title: Case: A recipient gets home to find no parcel after a delivery scan made while she was out
context: A recipient set a delivery instruction on the portal two days before delivery. The parcel was scanned as delivered mid-morning while she was at work.
initial_request: Home 13:40. Nothing on the step. Number 9 was in all morning. No knock, no parcel. Asked 7 and 11 as well. Nothing. Tracker says left with neighbour. The photo on the tracker is MY doormat. So which is it. I said not on the step. 34 minutes on hold to Whinmoor Arc and cut off. Not doing that again. Sort it.

events.body: DL-4840. Out Wednesday till about half one. If no answer leave with number 9, she's always in. NOT on the step, it faces the road.
Instruction added to DL-4840 (TG-3737, one carton, walking boots): 'If out, leave with neighbour at no. 9. Do not leave on step.' Shows on the driver handset at the stop.

DL-4840 scanned 22 Apr 10:48 as 'Delivered - left with neighbour'. No neighbour name, house number or signature captured. The stop photo shows a carton on a doormat in front of a green door; no house number is visible in the frame. We have not reviewed the stop beyond this; stop reviews are done by Delivery investigations on request, by email.

[Transferred from carrier phone line after 34 minutes in queue; call dropped after 40 seconds.] Ulric Blackwood: Finally. DL-4840. It says delivered and it is not here. I've been on hold since- [line lost]

Home 13:40. Nothing on the step. Number 9 was in all morning. No knock, no parcel. Asked 7 and 11 as well. Nothing. Tracker says left with neighbour. The photo on the tracker is MY doormat. So which is it. I said not on the step. 34 minutes on hold to Whinmoor Arc and cut off. Not doing that again. Sort it.

Please open a delivery investigation for DL-4840 (TG-3737, one carton). The 22 Apr 10:48 scan reads 'Delivered - left with neighbour' but no neighbour name, house number or signature was captured. The stop photo shows a carton on a doormat; the recipient, Ulric Blackwood, says that is her own doormat. The instruction on file since 20 Apr was 'If out, leave with neighbour at no. 9. Do not leave on step.' She got home at 13:40, found nothing on the step, and has already asked numbers 9, 7 and 11: number 9 was in all morning and had no knock, and none of them has it. So the scan, the photo and the instruction do not agree and the parcel is unaccounted for. I am not treating this as a confirmed loss or theft. Please review the stop record and the driver's account and tell me the investigation reference and when you will next update. She waited 34 minutes on the phone line today and was cut off, so please send the update in writing or through this desk instead of asking her to call in.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Delivery investigations, Whinmoor Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Tells Ulric Blackwood to check with her neighbours, or to wait and see whether it turns up, and treats the contact as dealt with.
States that the parcel was stolen, is lost, or was left with a neighbour as a settled fact.
Promises a refund, a replacement or a redelivery.
Tells Ulric Blackwood to phone the carrier line herself to report it.
Tells her the parcel was delivered correctly under safe-place terms or that the photo proves delivery.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2902: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 6) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
